title: Iason of Pheres
summary: Raleigh names Iason of Pheres in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iason, Tyrant of Pheres, brother of Nicasipolis. He is not the Iason already on record. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. IX, sig. 465a
